name: Coldridge Pass
summary: Troggs now bar the road through Coldridge Pass, the way out of Coldridge Valley.

sections.title: The Gateway Out of the Valley
sections.body: Recruits leave Coldridge Valley through Coldridge Pass and travel toward Kharanos. The tunnel cuts through Dun Morogh’s southern mountain ridge, carrying them from sheltered training grounds into the wider kingdom. Troggs have overrun the passage, threatening anyone who crosses between the valley and the rest of Dun Morogh.

faq.answer: Coldridge Pass leads from Coldridge Valley in the southwest to the rest of Dun Morogh. It opens among snowy hills just west of Kharanos.

faq.q: Why are there troggs in Coldridge Pass?
faq.answer: Troggs have surged from deep cracks beneath Dun Morogh and seized caves and tunnels across the region. Coldridge Pass shelters them and gives them a place to ambush travelers.

faq.q: Is Coldridge Pass safe to travel through?
aliases: can i walk through coldridge pass
faq.answer: No. Hostile troggs crowd the tunnel, so recruits and travelers must fight through or sprint in darkness to reach the far end.

faq.q: Who guards or maintains the pass?
faq.answer: Mountaineers watch the valley and road exits, but the tunnel remains contested and uncleared. Travelers must defend themselves as they cross.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you leave novice training at Anvilmar through Coldridge Pass to serve across Ironforge’s lands.
As a gnome, you must cross the trogg-held pass to reach Kharanos and the higher road toward Ironforge. There, you can aid the Alliance.
